the deep learning based approach can achieve good segmentation results in SSS image.
we propose to use a deep convolutional neural networks for side scan sonar segmentation.

In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of an end-to-end system to automatically segment SSS images into three parts: regions of objects, shadow areas and sea-bottom reverbration areas, which can provide useful information for the AUVs to do ocean survey.
the application of deep learning to side scan sonar segmentation.

the following aspects: (1) we propose to use a fully convolutional network (FCN) to do SSS image segmentation and train the network by using a large amount of sonar data; (2) we use a Markov random field (MRF) to post-process the segmentation results of the CNN; (3) we evaluate the performance of our proposed method by using a large dataset and the results are compared to those of the state-of-the-art methods.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
deep learning is an effective method for side scan sonar image segmentation and the results are promising.
deep CNN is a powerful tool for SSS image segmentation and can be used in other sonar images segmentation.
deep convolutional neural networks are a promising method in SSS segmentation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a new method to do SSS image segmentation by combining deep convolutional neural networks with Markov random fields, which can be applied in many other image segmentation problems.
we use CNN to segment SSS images into three parts and then post-process the results by MRF.
the CNN is a good choice for SSS image segmentation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
deep learning can be used for SSS image segmentation and the performance is promising.
deep convolutional networks can be used to extract image features for SSS image segmentation and the results are better than SVM.
deep CNN can be used to segment images from SSS.
